key_rules: SHORTWAVE SPLIT COMPATIBILITY: Organizational labels (Invoices, Operations, Accounting/Legal/HR, Bauwee, Finance & Funding, Sales & Marketing) MUST keep INBOX tag — never remove INBOX when applying org labels
THREAD PROTECTION: When relabeling threads for topic changes, add new organizational label WITHOUT removing INBOX; only Toss (archival) emails get INBOX removed
THREAD CONSISTENCY (STEP 0c): Find all labeled inbox threads, apply dominant label to ALL messages consistently — prevents threads being split across Shortwave folders
INVOICE LABELING: All invoice emails get Invoices label + INBOX (never archived unless spam/duplicate) — keeps them visible in Invoices split
PAYMENT FAILURES: Label 'Invoices' ONLY, keep in INBOX, never process/forward/archive — manual review required
LARGE INVOICE TRACKING: Non-EUR invoices >=EUR 1,000 trigger Asana task creation + database entry in large_pending_invoices
PAID = DEFAULT: SaaS receipts assumed PAID unless explicitly marked 'payment failed'
BRAINTOSS (TOSS LABEL): Only Toss emails get INBOX removed (true archive) — promotional/newsletter/auto-generated go here
NO CALENDAR EVENTS: Never auto-create calendar events from regular emails — scheduling is manual
DEDUPLICATION: 5-pass check (subject, sender, amount, date, snippet) prevents duplicate processing; tracks in processed_emails table
